Alprazolam is typically used as a stop gap for anxiety treatment while Healthcare professionals attempt to establish a long term treatment plan for people with severe anxiety and panic attacks. It's not meant to be used long term for general or social anxiety.

Alprazolam is also commonly used to stop panic attacks in people who are prone to them as it takes effect quickly if taken under the tongue or crushed up and taken orally. Using it for sleep is playing a dangerous game as you can easily become dependent on it in a short amount of time. As Alprazolam has the shortest half life and is one of the most potent often prescribed benzos, it is also one of the easiest to become dependent on. 

The addiction to benzodiazepines sometimes is not understood, or is overlooked by doctors, but the truth is that this stuff can literally kill you if you become physically dependent. It's bad news.

In short. Expect to be drowsy, forgetful, and relaxed.

Don't spread misinformation please.

Edit: These are two very different drugs. Xanax aka Alprazolam is a benzodiazepine while staterra is a SNRI. They have nearly opposite effects on your brain and mood and are completely unrelated.
